description: We’re Team HALO, a group of students from Riyadh who love space, games and building things that actually work. We split the work like a real mission crew: programmers built the game engine and the AI director, a teammate designed the four repair minigames, and the rest of us wrote the script, checked every science fact against NASA sources, and play-tested builds together. We wanted to make something a 9y/o would really want to play, that still teaches the hard choices real mission planners face
